summary: DATA-01 v2: canonical seed IDs (owner supplied two arXiv IDs) raise resolution to 10/10, and candidate discovery is fixed to OpenAlex arXiv-source + title.search + date bounds (3,226 reported; 200/200 arXiv, 0 missing abstracts; reference/related edges 200/200 absent). Probe now resolves explicit IDs authoritatively and flags title mismatches. DATA-01 stays in_progress; no quality claim.
scope_note: Covers the diff since commit 0047c87. Probe/tooling/docs; read-only public metadata; verification run replays from cache.

budget_impact.rationale: No app runtime and no model call. Only OpenAlex public metadata was read; this session spent roughly $0.0235 of the account's daily metered allowance. No provider operation or ceiling changed.
budget_impact.before: Seeds 8/10; candidate discovery used free-text search and returned an unusable pool with future dates.
budget_impact.after: Seeds 10/10 via explicit IDs; discovery = arXiv source + title.search + date bounds, 200/200 relevant-source entries with full abstracts; graph citation edges shown absent for the recent slice.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; tool/data-source facts only, not recommendation quality

open_risks: DATA-01 incomplete: no known-relevant recall set and no frozen time split yet.
OpenAlex reference/related edges absent for recent arXiv; graph feature needs another citation source.
Candidate pool is a single ~1-month slice.
